resolutions.researcher_notes: Dead current_ref (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/.../t2198133.shtml) has no web.archive.org snapshot (checked via wayback availability API: archived_snapshots={}) and geo-blocks from this environment. Substitute source: the underlying regulatory approval document itself, republished verbatim by independent trade portal gas.in-en.com (2019-07-25), archived and verified live. It is the Guangxi RDC's core-approval notice for this exact project (approval no. 桂发改油气〔2019〕705号, project code 2018-451029-57-02-036320), which by nature documents the project at its approved/pre-construction ('proposed') stage -- consistent with recorded Status=proposed. No newer construction/tender/gas-flow evidence for this specific branch was found (see prior deep-sweep audit rows/P4724.json status_reviews, which separately flags the status as potentially stale/shelved as of 2026 -- that is a distinct staleness judgment for the Update workflow, not a disagreement with what this source itself supports). Tier=high: a single primary/regulatory source (the regulator's own approval notice) qualifies at High per confidence_tiers.md, even though no second fully independent outlet was found (searched extensively per the prior audit's notes -- county-level tender databases, Tianlin/Baise government news portals -- none found for this specific 92km branch).
